title: Video Shoots and Production in Houston
metaTitle: Video Shoots and Production in Houston, TX | TDM
metaDescription: Video shoots for Houston companies, planned and scripted by TDM, filmed on location by our US-based team and edited into finished videos for every channel.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) plans, scripts and directs video shoots for Houston businesses and delivers the finished videos: brand films, capability videos, product videos and footage for ads and social. The filming is done by TDM's team in the United States, at your site or at whatever setting the project calls for, although we have no office or studio in Houston. Editing and the rest of post-production then take place at our operations office in Lahore. Planning, scripting and creative direction are included, and you approve the treatment before a camera is switched on.

sections.heading: What filming in Houston involves
paragraphs: A large part of what Houston companies need to film is on working sites: fabrication shops, laydown yards, terminals, labs and clinics. Anyone on site may need a safety orientation and protective equipment. Customer property, control screens and proprietary equipment may have to stay out of frame. Drone work needs a licensed operator and has limits near airports and certain facilities.

Then there is the climate. From late spring into early autumn, midday heat and humidity are hard on people and equipment, and afternoon storms are common. Outdoor scenes are best scheduled early in the day, with interior setups held in reserve. The Gulf storm season can force a postponement, so the plan should name a backup date.

For outdoor settings there is the downtown skyline from Buffalo Bayou Park, the Museum District and the older streets of the Heights. Filming on public property generally requires permission from the city or the body that manages the site, and private locations need the owner's consent.

sections.heading: How we organise a shoot
paragraphs: We begin with the purpose of the footage: which pages, ads and channels it will supply. From that we write treatments and scripts for your approval, then fix casting, locations, props, wardrobe and a shot-by-shot schedule. Our team in the United States films where you are and follows the approved shot list. The footage is then edited at our operations office in Lahore and comes back as finished videos in each format required.
bullets: Scripts written for a specific viewer, such as a procurement engineer, a patient or a homeowner.
A shot list planned backwards from the ads, product pages and social content the footage must fill.
Site access, safety and clearance requirements listed during pre-production.
A heat and weather plan for every outdoor scene.
Editing, grading and versioning in Lahore, briefed by the people who planned the shoot.

sections.heading: Location shoot or product shoot
paragraphs: A location shoot makes sense when the place or the people are the subject: a fabrication facility, a surgical practice, a dining room, a crew at work. When the product is the subject, the setting matters less than the light and the detail. A tool, a sensor, a bottle of barbecue sauce or a skincare range can be filmed by our US-based team on a plain set or a styled surface, away from your premises, and you approve the cuts online.

sections.heading: Before you book anyone
paragraphs: Settle what the videos are for first. Ask who is responsible for site permissions and releases from people who appear on camera. Ask whether editing is included or whether raw footage is all you receive. Confirm how many finished videos you will get.

faqs.q: Who does the filming, and is there a TDM studio in Houston?
faqs.a: Our own US-based team does the filming, on your premises or at a setting picked for the project. We do not keep an office or studio in Houston. Planning and scripting are handled online, and the edit is completed at our operations office in Lahore.

faqs.q: Can you film inside an industrial plant or fabrication shop?
faqs.a: It can be planned, subject to the site's rules. Access, safety orientation, protective equipment and what may appear on camera are set by the site owner. We build the shot list around them.

faqs.q: How much does a video shoot cost in Houston?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope: locations, talent, shoot days and the number of finished videos. We quote after a free consultation, once the purpose and shot list are clear.

faqs.q: When is the best time of year to film outdoors in Houston?
faqs.a: The cooler months are more comfortable for outdoor work. In summer, scenes are scheduled for the morning to avoid the worst heat and afternoon storms, and during the Gulf storm season it is wise to agree a backup date.

faqs.q: How long does it take to plan and deliver a shoot?
faqs.a: It depends on the brief, the locations and the permissions involved. The schedule is agreed in the plan.
